answers.how: Measured the bubble inside the hanging droplet moving downward by 195 px (in 2560x2560 original resolution) over 1.633 s (frames 0 to 49), giving a speed of 119.4 px/s and a scale of 1.206e-5 m/px from the 0.00144 m/s prior. The perpendicular outer diameter of the tilted glass plunge tube measures approximately 271 px, which converts to 0.00327 m.

Using the scale of 1.206e-5 m/px derived from the bubble speed prior (119.4 px/s = 0.00144 m/s), the horizontal width of the widest part of the hanging droplet measures approximately 148.5 px, giving 0.00179 m.

Using the scale of 1.206e-5 m/px derived from the bubble speed prior, the horizontal width of the vertical 'SKYNOVA' text column on the bottle measures approximately 141 px, corresponding to 0.00170 m.

Using the scale of 1.206e-5 m/px derived from the bubble speed prior, the vertical span of the 'SKYNOVA' lettering from the top of the 'A' to the bottom of the 'S' measures approximately 1262 px, corresponding to 0.0152 m.
